faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: Straight answers on Standard vs Pro, KPKT paperwork, and where your loan data lives.

items.question: What is TrueKredit™?
items.answer: TrueKredit™ is a money lending management system / money lender software Malaysia built for KPKT-licensed money lenders. It holds borrower profiles, loan products, applications and approvals, disbursement controls, repayment schedules, collections and the KPKT paperwork that goes with all of it — Lampiran A, B, B1, Jadual J & K, and iDEAL (sistem iDEAL) exports — in one place, on your own secure cloud.

items.question: What do Standard and Pro both include?
items.answer: The full core platform: borrower profiles, flexible loan products, counter applications and approvals, affordability and risk scoring, payment vouchers with two-person payout approval, repayment schedules and arrears, KPKT paperwork and exports, portfolio reporting with role-based access, and your own secure cloud in Malaysia. Identity, company and payment integrations are connected at no additional connection fee. Pro does not take anything away from Standard.

items.question: What is exclusive to TrueKredit Pro?
items.answer: The nationwide layer: a branded customer website on your own domain, iPhone and Android apps, digital signing on your premises verified with MSC Trustgate, digital attestation live at the counter or by scheduled video call, and support for KPKT Online Money Lending Licence reviews. Your team keeps the same admin workflows; new channels feed the same loan file.

items.question: What do borrowers see on the website and apps?
items.answer: On TrueKredit™ Pro, borrowers use a branded website on your domain and iPhone or Android apps. They apply, upload documents, verify identity, track balances, pay instalments and sign agreements. Every action lands on the same loan file your team works in — nothing is re-keyed.

items.question: Can we start on Standard and upgrade to Pro later?
items.answer: Yes, and most lenders do. Start on Standard for your branch today. Upgrading adds the customer channels, signing and attestation on top of the system you already run. Your borrowers, loans and history stay exactly where they are — nothing is migrated and nothing is re-keyed.

items.question: Do you support Lampiran A, B, B1, Jadual J & K, and iDEAL KPKT?
items.answer: Yes. Schedules, Lampiran A, B and B1, Jadual J and Jadual K (Schedule J & K), payment receipts and default notices are generated from the same loan records your team works in, with exports shaped for KPKT submission including sistem iDEAL. Nobody retypes a form.

items.question: Where is our data kept, and is it shared with other lenders?
items.answer: Your loan data lives on your own secure cloud account, hosted in Malaysia, and is never pooled with another lender's book. Daily backups and a complete record of every action come as standard, on both plans. Upgrading to Pro keeps that same environment.

items.question: Which checks are included, and what do they cost?
items.answer: TrueIdentity™ e-KYC, TrueSSM™ company lookups and the payment gateway (FassPay and GKash) are already wired in, on both plans. There is no fee to connect them — you pay only for each check or transaction you run. CTOS credit pulls and TrueSight™ AI risk scoring are coming.

items.question: Can TrueKredit handle refinance, top-up and reschedule?
items.answer: Yes. Each path is approved and tracked on the same loan file, so the change and the reason behind it stay in the history rather than becoming a new, disconnected loan. Available as an optional add-on on both plans.

items.question: Can we configure TrueKredit to match how we already lend?
items.answer: Yes. Approval uploads before L2, AML confirmation, LHDN stamp certificates, and maker-checker on disbursements are each turned on or off to match how your office already works. Your team keeps their process — the system follows it.
